author: Nadine Grimley
title: Man found guilty of murdering sister - NewsBreak
text:
By Nadine Grimley ,
9 hours ago
WARREN, Ohio (WKBN) — After an hour and a half of deliberations, a Trumbull County jury has convicted John Zanolli in the death of his sister , Janice Zanolli.
John Zanolli was found guilty of aggravated murder, the firearms specification, and abuse of a corpse.
Prosecutors say back in February 2025, John shot Janice twice while she was in her bed at the Masury home of their late parents, where they both had been living. They say John left Janice lying in a pool of her own blood for days after he killed her, while he carried on with his life, even going to get Chinese food while she was dead inside the home.
John’s attorneys argued he didn’t plan the tragedy, but snapped over Janice’s threats to evict him.
“The bottom line is Mr. Zanolli was being kicked out of his house and everybody agrees on that too and as a result of being kicked out, he snapped,” said Sharay Lewis, Zanolli’s attorney.
It only took the jury an hour and a half to find Zanolli guilty.
Prosecutors say they’re pleased with the verdict.
“I know the jury didn’t spend a whole lot of time in terms of being in the deliberations. I think that’s a great credit to the Brookfield Police Department,” said Assistant Prosecutor Chris Becker. “We couldn’t do it without the great jurors we have here in Trumbull County.”
Judge Sean O’Brien revoked Zanolli’s bond and oredered he undergo a presentence investigation. Sentencing will be set at a later date.
